_comment: Canonical proposal flow (Phase 2: creative-depth). 'required' slides always appear; 'optional' are dropped when not relevant; 'service_gated' appear only if that service is in the mix; 'client_gated: existing' appears only for clients whose socials we already run. Target 14-18 slides — drop any slide that doesn't earn its place. The deck engine reads this order; deck.json lists the actual slides chosen.

slide_order.note: Brand x Agency lockup + campaign theme
Who we are + the relevant services
Real metrics from the account we already run — our unfair advantage
Their challenge, in their words
Move-centric: a market read + 2-4 'moves we adapt' (competitors as evidence, not a roll-call)
Current IG/TikTok trends for the category + our play (dated + sourced; re-pulled each pitch)
THE narrative. Name it.
The campaign as a narrative arc, beat by beat — SHOW 'we build narratives'
How we tackle it — the framework
3-4 content pillars: theme + why + formats
Day/week x format grid for the window
DESIGNED post-cards: format + concept + real caption + CTA
Phases + timing (fold into calendar for short campaigns)
Scope per active service line
KOL CARDS: roster + fresh discovered faces (to-vet)
Photographer/videographer/editor/MUA/etc.
Aesthetic direction: client photos (hero) + labeled references
Everything the client receives
Proof: real past results matched to category (verified only)
IDR line items + 50/30/20. OPTIONAL — omit until pricing is ready
The payoff funnel: what the investment converts into (awareness→interest→intent→bookings). All figures provenance=target, benchmarked to verified wins
Pricing-deferred fallback: 'what's included — investment to follow'
The philosophy line from config/brand.json
CTA + contact block

guidance: Lead with craft, not price. Use insider_data only for existing clients. Show the storyline + designed content_examples — that's the differentiator. Include EITHER investment OR scope_summary, not both. Never ship a placeholder image or an empty KOL slide.
